author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
We're back with The Indie Hour Episode Sixty-Three! This series focuses on games you may have never even heard of and gives us an inside look at the wider world of independantly published Tabletop Wargames of all genres.

Looking for a Depression Simulator? Love Cormac McCarthy Novels? Do you ALSO consider The Book of Eli an underratted Gary Oldman Gem? Then The Last Mile is probably for you! Let's check it out!

Check out the details HERE: https://blacksitestudio.com/en-ca/products/last-mile-zine
title: The GMG Indie Hour Ep 063 - The Last Mile by Black Site Studio
